nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; set in constructor from msg.sender and updated in acceptOwnership.
Pending new owner address, set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Token symbol string, set to NESTADE in the constructor.
Token name string, set to 'Nestade Token' in the constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply, set in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of address to token balance; read and written by transfer, transferFrom, balanceOf and totalSupply.
Nested mapping of owner to spender allowances; written by approve and approveAndCall, consumed by transferFrom and allowance.
Safe addition helper using require(c >= a) to prevent overflow.
Safe subtraction helper using require(b <= a) to prevent underflow.
Safe multiplication helper using require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Safe division helper using require(b > 0).
Constructor of Owned; assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
Owner-only function that stages a new owner in newOwner; protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
Two-step ownership handover completing when msg.sender equals newOwner; moves owner and clears newOwner.
Token constructor that initialises symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-mints all tokens to a fixed address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns balances[tokenOwner] for an arbitrary address.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd on the balances mapping.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no checks for the approval double-spend race.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] without verifying the allowance is sufficient.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets an allowance and then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval, making an external interaction after a state write.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
Owner-only rescue function that performs an arbitrary external ERC20 transfer call to a caller-supplied token address.
msg.sender used in the Owned constructor to initialise the owner state variable.
msg.sender compared against owner inside the onlyOwner modifier used by transferOwnership and transferAnyERC20Token.
msg.sender compared against newOwner in acceptOwnership to authorise the ownership handover.
msg.sender used as the source account in transfer.
msg.sender used as the allowance owner key in approve.
msg.sender used as the spender key when decrementing allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
msg.sender used as allowance owner and forwarded into the external receiveApproval callback in approveAndCall.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after the allowed mapping is written, enabling callback reentrancy into token state.
Arbitrary external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to a caller-controlled address; guarded only by onlyOwner.
transferFrom subtracts from allowed[from][msg.sender] using safeSub but never requires the allowance to be sufficient, allowing an approved spender to relay more than permitted.
